name: Offline Check
subtitle: Find every spot where Media offline actually shows
description: Checks the open sequence for frames that show Premiere's red Media offline slate. Offline clips you cannot see are fine and are not flagged: clips on a hidden track (eye off), disabled clips, and clips fully covered by a solid full-frame clip above. Everywhere else it renders stills and looks for the slate in them, so a slate showing through a faded layer or around a picture-in-picture is caught. Each place gets a red marker called Media offline (earlier ones from this check are replaced; your own markers are never touched) and a row in the list below; click a row to jump there. Clear markers removes only this check's markers. Media Pending is not checked. Nothing is saved.
